items.title: Pixel Search could soon get a Gemini-powered upgrade along with privacy improvements
items.excerpt: Pixel Search could soon get a Gemini-powered upgrade along with privacy improvements — New Pixel Search update introduces a "Privacy & Permissions" section letting users stop the app from using their data to improve suggestions.
items.rationale: Gemini moving into the Pixel launcher's search bar, with a new control over whether your data trains suggestions. It covers a different surface from the published Pixel Buds and Call for Me cards and adds a fifth outlet.

dedup.note: SWAP (10-06): removed the TDK retinal-display pick (Notebookcheck) because the full-article check found the body never mentions AI; it is a pure optics story. Replaced it with Android Authority's Pixel Search Gemini teardown, the best remaining candidate where AI is central to the device. Its history_match (09-29 Pixel Buds Gemini controls) is a different product surface, and no published card covers Pixel launcher search, so it is new.
